subscriptionWelcomeSubject: Welcome to Jawab24 — your {plan} plan is active
subscriptionWelcomeIntro: Hi {name}, thanks for subscribing to Jawab24. Your {plan} plan is active and ready to use.
subscriptionWelcomeTrialNote: Your free trial runs until {trialEnd}. You can cancel any time before then and you won't be charged.
subscriptionWelcomeNextSteps: Next: connect your Facebook or Instagram page, then add your Business Info. We'll handle the rest.
subscriptionWelcomeBilling: A separate invoice email with billing details will arrive from Stripe shortly.
trialEndingSubject: Your Jawab24 free trial ends on {trialEnd}
trialEndingIntro: Hi {name}, your Jawab24 free trial ends on {trialEnd}. Subscribe before then and your replies keep running without interruption.
trialEndingWhatHappens: If the trial ends without a subscription, automatic replies stop — your Business Info, pages and conversation history all stay exactly as they are.
trialEndedSubject: Your Jawab24 free trial has ended — replies are paused
trialEndedIntro: Hi {name}, your Jawab24 free trial has ended, and automatic replies to your customers' messages and comments have stopped.
trialEndedWhatRemains: Your Business Info, pages and conversation history are all saved exactly as they were. Subscribe now and your replies resume right where they left off.
paymentFailedSubject: Action needed: your Jawab24 renewal payment did not go through
paymentFailedIntro: Hi {name}, we tried to renew your Jawab24 subscription ({amount}), but the payment was declined by your card's issuing bank.
paymentFailedIntroNoAmount: Hi {name}, we tried to renew your Jawab24 subscription, but the payment was declined by your card's issuing bank.
paymentFailedGrace: Automatic replies keep running until {graceEnd}. If payment is not completed before then, replies to your customers will stop automatically.
paymentFailedGraceUnknown: If payment is not completed within the next few days, automatic replies to your customers will stop.
paymentFailedUpdateCard: You can pay with the same card or any other card that supports online payments. If the card keeps being declined, ask its issuer to enable online purchases.
serviceSuspendedSubject: Auto-replies have stopped — your Jawab24 subscription is awaiting payment
serviceSuspendedIntro: Hi {name}, we did not receive your subscription renewal payment, so automatic replies to your customers' messages and comments stopped on {stoppedSince}.
serviceSuspendedWhatRemains: Your Business Info, pages and conversation history are all saved exactly as they were. Complete the payment and your replies resume right where they left off.
paymentRecoveredSubject: Payment received — your Jawab24 subscription is active
paymentRecoveredIntro: Hi {name}, your payment went through and your subscription is active until {periodEnd}. Automatic replies are running as usual.
autoPausedSubject: Action needed: auto-reply is paused for {pageName}
autoPausedIntro: Facebook has repeatedly rejected replies on your page {pageName}, so Jawab24 paused auto-reply to protect your reply quota. Your customers' messages and comments are going unanswered until this is fixed.
autoPausedFixSteps: Fix it in two steps: 1) Open Jawab24 and reconnect the page, completing the Facebook sign-in when asked. 2) Turn auto-reply back on.
autoPausedPasswordNote: If you recently changed your Facebook password, reconnecting is required — signing in and out of Facebook alone will not restore the connection. Also check that your page is not restricted or unpublished on Facebook.
pageReconnectCausePasswordChanged: Your Facebook password was changed, so Facebook ended the connection that lets Jawab24 reply on behalf of {pageName}.
pageReconnectCauseLoggedOut: Your Facebook account was signed out, so Facebook ended the connection that lets Jawab24 reply on behalf of {pageName}.
pageReconnectCauseSecurityCheckpoint: Facebook asked you to confirm your account, and ended the connection that lets Jawab24 reply on behalf of {pageName}.
pageReconnectCauseTokenExpired: The Facebook connection for {pageName} reached its expiry date, so Jawab24 can no longer reply on its behalf.
pageReconnectCausePermissionsRevoked: Jawab24's permissions were removed from your Facebook account, so it can no longer reply on behalf of {pageName}.
pageReconnectCauseUnknown: Facebook ended the connection that lets Jawab24 reply on behalf of {pageName}.
pageReconnectImpact: Until you reconnect, messages and comments from your customers are going unanswered.
pageReconnectFixSteps: Open Jawab24, go to Pages, and reconnect the page — completing the Facebook sign-in when asked. It takes less than a minute.
pageReconnectPasswordNote: Signing in and out of Facebook is not enough: Jawab24 needs a new authorization, which only reconnecting from inside the app can give it.
inviteEmailSubject: You've been invited to join {workspace} on Jawab24
inviteEmailIntro: You've been invited to join the {workspace} workspace on Jawab24 — the assistant that auto-replies to your Facebook & Instagram comments and messages. Accept the invitation to get started.
inviteEmailExpiry: This invitation link expires in 48 hours.
inviteEmailIgnore: If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.
waHandoffBody: You'll continue on Facebook to choose your WhatsApp number. You're already signed in — we'll bring you back here when you're done.
waReturnBody: Finishing up — taking you back to the app.
